verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page says users can "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA" through their online account (cra-docs-8). EFILE filers can also sign in to view transmission history (cra-docs-16, cra-docs-17). However, both require an authenticated account rather than public pages, and the evidence is a single brief mention with no specific coverage of business registration, application, or case status. Missing for 10: a status-lookup page reachable from public pages without sign-in, explicit status tracking for BN/program-account registrations and cases, detailed documentation of the tracking feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
